num_builders.help: The number of new builder keys you want to generate (you can always generate more later)
num_builders.prompt: Please choose how many new builders you wish to register

folder.help: The folder path for the keystore(s) and builder deposit(s). Pointing to `./builder_keys` by default.

chain.help: The name of Ethereum PoS chain you are targeting. Use "mainnet" if you are depositing ETH
chain.prompt: Please choose the (mainnet or testnet) network/chain name

keystore_password.help: The password that will secure your keystores. You will need to re-enter this to decrypt them when you setup your builder(s). (It is recommended not to use this argument, and wait for the CLI to ask you for your password, as otherwise it will appear in your shell history.)
keystore_password.prompt: Create a password that secures your builder keystore(s). You will need to re-enter this to decrypt them when you setup your builder(s).
keystore_password.confirm: Repeat your keystore password for confirmation
keystore_password.mismatch: Error: the two entered values do not match. Please type again.

arg_execution_address.help: The Ethereum address that will be used as the builder's execution (withdrawal) address. It typically starts with '0x' followed by 40 hexadecimal characters. Please make sure you have full control over the address you choose here. This is required for builders: unlike validators, there is no BLS-only withdrawal type, and this address is also the sole authorization for a future builder exit.
arg_execution_address.prompt: Please enter the execution address for this builder. This is required, and CANNOT be changed once set on chain.
arg_execution_address.confirm: Repeat your execution address for confirmation.
arg_execution_address.mismatch: Error: the two entered values do not match. Please type again.

arg_builder_amount.help: The amount to deposit to these builders in ether denomination. Must be at least 1 ether and can not have greater precision than 1 gwei. Unlike validator deposits, there is no protocol-defined maximum.
arg_builder_amount.prompt: Please enter the amount you wish to deposit to these builders. Must be at least 1 ether and can not have greater precision than 1 gwei. There is no maximum.

arg_pbkdf2.help: Uses the pbkdf2 hashing function instead of scrypt for generated keystore files.

arg_devnet_chain_setting.help: [DEVNET ONLY] Set specific GENESIS_FORK_VERSION value. This should be a JSON string containing an object with the following keys: network_name, genesis_fork_version, exit_fork_version, genesis_validator_root, multiplier, min_activation_amount and min_deposit_amount. It should be similar to what you can find in settings.py. This will override any selected chain.
